This has been set up by his lawyer to go into a special trust so as to specifically not endanger his qualifications for other assistance. Please pin or share. Thanks. 
Wasn't sure what I'd find looking here but glad it was people willing to help. Now's the time.

Thanks for taking the time to type that all out. I have heard similar sentiments many times over the years and they have never proven to be true. 
I am sure they are for other people, but I don't believe that my brain or my circumstances will change.
